  • Class
    Description
    EgradxAuthErrorCodes
    Stable, machine-readable codes carried on the exceptions this module throws (via getEgradxErrorCode() on the com.egradx.core.exception types).
    EgradxAuthorities
    The authority vocabulary this module owns — the permissions that gate egradx-auth's own endpoints.
    EgradxAuthorities.Definition
    One entry of the seeded catalog.
    EgradxAuthorityCatalog
    Every authority egradx-auth manages: its own (EgradxAuthorities) plus those contributed by other libraries (EgradxAuthorityContributor).
    EgradxAuthorityContributor
    Lets another library add its own authorities to egradx-auth's catalog — declared once, in code, rather than seeded by every application that uses it.
    EgradxAuthPackageMarker
    Anchors @AutoConfigurationPackage on com.egradx.auth, so this module's entities and repositories are registered alongside the host application's rather than replacing them.
    EgradxAuthService
    The single entry point apps built on egradx-sdk call to register, log in, refresh, log out, and validate users — in-process, no separate auth microservice to run or call.
    EgradxDetailedException
    A refusal whose error envelope carries details, for a client to say more than the code alone.
    EgradxDetailedException.Conflict
    A 409 with details.
    EgradxDetailedException.Forbidden
    A 403 with details.
    EgradxIamFacade
    What the two IAM controller surfaces both sit on.
    EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService
    Creating a usable organization in one transaction: the organization, the Admin role every organization is guaranteed to have, and the first user who can log in and administer it.
    EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService.Provisioned
    What EgradxOrganizationProvisioningService.provision(com.egradx.auth.dto.EgradxCreateOrganizationRequest) made: the organization and its first administrator's user id.
    EgradxOrganizationSelectionRequiredException
    Sign-in succeeded, but the person belongs to more than one organization and did not say which to enter.
    EgradxOrganizationService
    Create/suspend/activate an organization — deliberately minimal.
    EgradxPlatformOrganization
    Answers "which organization is the platform organization?" — the one question the rest of the module needs in order to treat it as the head of the platform.
    EgradxRefreshTokens
    How a refresh token is stored: as the lowercase hex SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes, never as itself, so a copy of the database cannot be turned into working sessions (contracts/test-vectors/refresh-token.json, auth migration V5).
    EgradxRoleService
    Manages roles and their granular authorities, and assigns/revokes a user's role within a specific organization.
    EgradxSignupRequiredException
    A provider proved who someone is, but they have no account, and signing up is open: a 409 whose details carry the email, name and provider to sign up with (POST /egradx/auth/oidc/signup).
    EgradxTooManyAttemptsException
    Too many wrong passwords from here; try again after EgradxTooManyAttemptsException.retryAfter().
    EgradxUserService
    Administering the users inside one organization: who's a member, adding someone with a role, changing their details or role, deactivating them.
